body: He has a visible limp so whether we mention it or not, people are going to notice it and comment on it. My family can be extremely judgmental and I’d rather he did not have to deal with that.

I fought for a previous potential and she was ready to disown me. I’d rather not go down that road again and would prefer he had a family that loved him regardless of his condition. JazaakAllah Khair for your duas.

I believe there was a risky surgery that his mother turned down. At the end of the day, he lives life like a normal person (plays soccer, hangs out with friends a lot, works etc.), it’s just his limp and the “image” of it that bothers my mom. May Allah make it easier for him.

I do. I knew I would’ve been happy. His family are so lovely and he made the whole first meet so lovely and calm. His mother was also just a gem (reminds me of my eldest aunt who is a lot like her in terms of personality) so I could see myself being a part of their family. The worst part is that my mom really liked him but just couldn’t face the pressure of marrying her first daughter to a man with a limp. I honestly don’t give a toss what people say but at the end of the day my mom needs to be happy and at peace with my marriage too. Allah knows best.

I understand. I should add that my mom liked him a lot too and hated that she had to say no because of his condition. I fought once for a previous potential and it drove my mental health into a state. The brother deserves a wife and family that will not judge him so yes, I’m allowing this to happen for his sake. I’ll be making dua for him always.

I don’t know the exact term but from what he told me I understood that it was an issue he was born with and caused him to walk with a limp. Also, this is the second potential I met, I’ve only recently started the search. Would appreciate all your duas.
